title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "Zheyre Tolliver"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  summarize(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(tucaseid, sex, major_name)) |>
  summarize(avg_daily_min = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(sex, major_name)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
hourly_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  filter(major_code %in% c(1, 2, 3, 12)) |>
  mutate(hour = floor(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  filter(hour >= 6, hour <= 23) |>
  summarize(minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(tucaseid, sex, major_name, hour)) |>
  summarize(avg_min = mean(minutes, na.rm = TRUE),
            .by = c(sex, major_name, hour)) |>
  arrange(sex, major_name, hour) |>
  collect()

```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_daily_min,
             y = fct_reorder(major_name, avg_daily_min),
             fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Female = "#9b6fc9", Male = "#c9b3e3")) +
  labs(
    title = "How Americans Without Jobs Spend Their Weekdays",
    subtitle = "Average daily minutes per category, among respondents who did the activity",
    x = "Average minutes per day",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey, Bureau of Labor Statistics"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
hourly_avg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = avg_min, fill = major_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21),
    labels = c("6 AM", "9 AM", "12 PM", "3 PM", "6 PM", "9 PM")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ece4f5", "#c9b3e3", "#9b6fc9", "#5b3a80")) +
  labs(
    title = "How Nonemployed Americans Spend Their Weekdays",
    subtitle = "Average minutes in activities starting each hour, by sex",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Activity",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey, Bureau of Labor Statistics"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
